data.title: 丰川祥子 · 唱片店试听的午后
data.description: 唱片店试听角，祥子穿浅灰开衫和藏蓝长裙，用一只手扶住耳机，另一只手在膝上轻轻打拍。听到喜欢的和声时，她停止数拍，金黄色眼睛抬起来，嘴角终于有了很淡的笑。
data.action: 扶住耳机在膝上打拍，听到和声后停手浅笑。
data.promptProse: At the record shop's listening station, Sakiko Togawa holds one headphone cup while her other hand rests on the navy skirt after tapping the beat. A grey cardigan covers her pale-blue blouse as her yellow eyes lift into a faint smile. The medium portrait includes the small turntable beside her and record sleeves along the wall. Soft frontal shop light reveals headphone curves and cover textures, with gentle shelf shadows behind her blue ribbons.
